name: The More You Wet In Training
source:
Your old friend Edward has asked you for help. For six hours he will go about his business, alone with you...

[From [url=https://www.omorashi.org/files/file/14716-the-more-you-wet-in-training/]site[/url]]
translation:
老朋友愛德華向你求助。接下來六個小時，他會照常做自己的事，身邊只有你一個人……
